map.CAGE问卷，筛查酒精使用障碍。4个是/否问题，每答一个\"是\"得1分。总分≥: The CAGE questionnaire screens for alcohol use disorder. Four yes/no questions; each 'yes' scores 1. Total >=2 suggests alcohol-related problems requiring further assessment.
map.CAGE四项各答“是”计1分；总分 = 肯定项数；≥2分筛查阳性，提示酒精相关问: Each 'yes' on the four CAGE items scores 1; total = number of affirmative answers; >=2 is a positive screen, indicating alcohol-related risk.
map.暂无明显酒精问题: No obvious alcohol problem for now
map.提示酒精相关问题，建议进一步评估AUDIT: Suggests alcohol-related problems; further AUDIT assessment advised
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科/成瘾科专业诊断。CAGE针对酒精；CAGE: This scale is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric/addiction-medicine diagnosis. CAGE targets alcohol; CAGE-AID extends to drug use. For addiction, consult addiction medicine.
map.4 题（是=1/否=0）：Cut down 是、Annoyed 否、Guilty: 4 items (yes=1/no=0): Cut down yes, Annoyed no, Guilty yes, Eye-opener no -> 2 points, positive screen; AUDIT further assessment advised.
map.4 题全否 → 0 分，暂未达阳性，仍建议健康宣教。: All 4 items no -> 0 points, not yet positive; health education still advised.
map.CAGE 简洁、敏感性高，适合床旁快速初筛；阳性即应深入评估饮酒量与时程。: CAGE is brief and sensitive, ideal for quick bedside screening; a positive result warrants deeper assessment of amount and duration of drinking.
map.原为酒精设计，对其它物质可作初筛但不如专用量表（如 DAST）精准。: Originally designed for alcohol; it can screen other substances but is less precise than dedicated scales (e.g. DAST).
map.关于「物质依赖(CAGE)问卷器」: About the CAGE Substance Use Questionnaire
map.物质依赖(CAGE)问卷器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: CAGE Substance Use Questionnaire. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
